+type SQLServerPinger struct{}

+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}

+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}

+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return trace.Wrap(conn.Close())
+}

+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) {
+		return true
+	}
+	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused")
+}

+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err, 18456, 18452)
+}
+

+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err, 4060, 911, 916)
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error, numbers ...int32) bool {
+	var serverErr mssql.Error
+	if !errors.As(err, &serverErr) {
+		var pointerErr *mssql.Error
+		if !errors.As(err, &pointerErr) {
+			return false
+		}
+		serverErr = *pointerErr
+	}
+	for _, number := range numbers {
+		if serverErr.Number == number {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
